name: Berggasthaus Stimmlach
beschreibung: The Berggasthaus Stimmlach is an inn in the municipality of Westendorf in Brixental. The establishment is run as a family-run house with a guest parlour. The rooms are simply and practically furnished. The kitchen offers Tiroler specialties such as Knödel and Kaiserschmarrn. In winter, the inn is close to the ski slopes of SkiWelt Wilder Kaiser-Brixental. In summer, the house serves as a base for hikers and mountain bikers. A beer garden is open in the warmer months. The accommodation is geared toward half-board stays.
